Picks are sealed and made at the same time; you see only your own pack and your own quarry, and every quarry is shown when the game ends. Scoring at the end of the game: each of the four resources scores the square of the cards you hold of it (1 card 1, 2 cards 4, 3 cards 9, 4 cards 16, ...). A lodestone is wild: it joins one of your sets as one more card, at most one lodestone per set, and goes to your biggest sets.
